title: England Fans Serenade Men’s Team With Epic Oasis Singalong After Thrilling FIFA World Cup Win
summary: England kicked off their 2026 campaign with a thrilling 4-2 win over Croatia
contentText:
After a thrilling win in their opening match at the FIFA World Cup , England fans serenaded their team with an epic singalong to Oasis ’ “Wonderwall” on Wednesday (June 18) England kicked off their FIFA World Cup campaign in Dallas, Texas against Croatia, winning 4-2 in a match that puts them at the top of their group, ahead of Ghana, who also won their opening game against Panama.

The match was one of the tournament’s strongest opening round performances, with Harry Kane scoring twice alongside goals by Jude Bellingham and Marcus Rashford. England lead twice in the first half before being pegged back by sublime efforts by Croatia’s Martin Baturina and Petar Musa.

Following the conclusion of the match, the England team were serenaded with a rendition of Oasis’ 1995 track “Wonderwall” with players Anthony Gordon, Bellingham and Kane showing signs of emotion as the song was roared back to them by the Three Lion supporters.

A clip shared by BBC Sport on Instagram was reposted by both Oasis’ and Liam Gallagher’s main social accounts. Watch it here .

Oasis’ connection with football runs deep, with both Gallagher brothers being avid supporters of their local team Manchester City F.C.

While no official anthem has been released for England’s campaign for the 2026 tournament, a number of old classics associated with the team have been revived by supporters, including “Three Lions” by The Lightning Seeds and Baddiel & Skinner, “Sweet Caroline” by Neil Diamond and “Freed from Desire” by Gala. England’s in-stadium goal music for the tournament – played after each score – is “Chase The Sun” by Planet Funk, a song that was popularized by the U.K.’s rowdy darts tournaments.

England’s next match will be held in Boston against Ghana on Tuesday (June 23) before moving onto the New York New Jersey Stadium to round out Group L’s action against Panama the following Saturday.
